parameters.query:
SELECT 
  s.uniqueref                   AS scan_ref,
  s.sentrix_id,
  s.chiptype_ref,
  i.uniqueref                   AS idat_uniqueref,
  i.position,
  i.sample_id,
  i.rescan_count,
  i.gtc_file_path,
  i.green_idat_path,
  i.red_idat_path
FROM scans s
LEFT JOIN idats i ON i.scan_ref = s.uniqueref
WHERE s.sentrix_id = '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'
ORDER BY i.position;

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
SENTRIX={{ $json.sentrix_id }}
BPM={{ $json.chip_config.bpm }}
EGT={{ $json.chip_config.egt }}
SUBDIR={{ $json.chip_config.staging_subdir }}
LABEL_PREFIX={{ $json.chip_config.label_prefix }}

DRAGENA=/staging/tools/dragena-linux-x64-DAv1.4.0-rc2-sha.9b051a4be2c6ade41bfa804c3bccc41cdbdc1c5b/dragena/dragena
STAGING=/staging/array
SCANS=/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans
IDAT_DIR=$SCANS/$SENTRIX
OUTPUT_DIR=$SCANS/GTCs/$SENTRIX
GTC_DIR=$OUTPUT_DIR/gtc
QC_DIR=$OUTPUT_DIR/qc_report
LABEL="${LABEL_PREFIX}_${SENTRIX}"
LOCK=$OUTPUT_DIR/.dragena.lock

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"locked\",\"pid\":\"$PID\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\"}"
    exit 0
  else
    rm -f "$LOCK"
  fi
fi

echo $$ > "$LOCK"
trap 'rm -f "$LOCK"' EXIT INT TERM

if [ ! -d "$IDAT_DIR" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"idat_dir_missing\",\"path\":\"$IDAT_DIR\"}"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$BPM" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"bpm_missing\",\"path\":\"$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$BPM\"}"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$EGT" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"egt_missing\",\"path\":\"$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$EGT\"}"
  exit 1
fi

rm -rf "$GTC_DIR"
mkdir -p "$GTC_DIR"

"$DRAGENA" genotype call \
  --bpm-manifest "$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$BPM" \
  --cluster-file "$STAGING/$SUBDIR/$EGT" \
  --idat-folder "$IDAT_DIR" \
  --output-folder "$GTC_DIR" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" 2>&1

GTC_RC=$?
if [ "$GTC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  TAIL=$(tail -5 "$OUTPUT_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
  echo "{\"status\":\"gtc_failed\",\"rc\":$GTC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"$TAIL\"}"
  exit 1
fi

rm -rf "$QC_DIR"
mkdir -p "$QC_DIR"

"$DRAGENA" qc report \
  --data "$GTC_DIR" \
  --output-folder "$QC_DIR" \
  --label "$LABEL" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/dragena_qc.log" 2>&1

QC_RC=$?
if [ "$QC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  TAIL=$(tail -5 "$OUTPUT_DIR/dragena_qc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
  echo "{\"status\":\"qc_failed\",\"rc\":$QC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"$TAIL\"}"
  exit 1
fi

GTC_COUNT=$(ls "$GTC_DIR"/*.gtc 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
QC_XLSX=$(ls -t "$QC_DIR"/DRAGENArray_QC_table_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -1)
QC_XLSX_BASENAME=$(basename "$QC_XLSX")

N8N_GTC_DIR=$(echo "$GTC_DIR" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
N8N_QC_DIR=$(echo "$QC_DIR" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
N8N_QC_XLSX=$(echo "$QC_XLSX" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')

echo "{\"status\":\"success\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"gtc_dir\":\"$N8N_GTC_DIR\",\"qc_dir\":\"$N8N_QC_DIR\",\"qc_xlsx\":\"$N8N_QC_XLSX\",\"qc_xlsx_basename\":\"$QC_XLSX_BASENAME\",\"label\":\"$LABEL\",\"gtc_count\":$GTC_COUNT}"
BASH_SCRIPT

parameters.query:
UPDATE idats
SET
  gtc_file_path = '{{ $json.gtc_file_path }}',
  estimated_gender = '{{ $json.estimated_gender }}',
  manifest_bpm_concept_ref = {{ $json.manifest_bpm_concept_ref }},
  manifest_csv_concept_ref = {{ $json.manifest_csv_concept_ref }},
  cluster_file_concept_ref = {{ $json.cluster_file_concept_ref }},
  updated_at = now()
WHERE uniqueref = {{ $json.uniqueref }};
